name: Lalbhai Dalpatbhai College of Engineering
administration: Directorate of Technical Education, Government of Gujarat
address: Opposite Gujarat University, Navrangpura, Ahmedabad - 380015, Gujarat, India
about: LDCE is one of Ahmedabad's premier engineering institutions. It is surrounded by PRL, ATIRA, ISRO, IIM-A, and CEPT. Established in 1948 for quality higher education in engineering.

stats.patents: 25+ patents filed by students and faculty

admissions.ug: UG admission through ACPC / state counselling as per GTU and government norms. Check ldce.ac.in Admissions section for current notices.
admissions.pg: PG admission through GTU PGCET and institute criteria.
admissions.working_professional: Working Professional Programs available — see Admissions on website.
admissions.contact_note: For exact dates, fees, and forms visit the Admissions page on ldce.ac.in or contact the admission cell.

fees.note: Fee structure varies by program (UG/PG), category, and government revision. Pay fees online via Fees Payment on ldce.ac.in. For exact semester fees contact the accounts section or check latest circulars.
fees.payment: Online fee payment available on the institute website under Fees Payment.

placement.overview: LDCE has active campus placement with recruiters from IT, core engineering, and analytics sectors.
placement.contact_note: Placement cell coordinates internships and campus drives — check Placement section on website.

facilities.hostel: Hostel facility available for students — apply through student section / hostel office.
facilities.library: Central library with books, journals, and digital resources.
facilities.sports: Sports facilities and teams for various games.
facilities.student_section: Student Section handles certificates, ID, and administrative student services.
facilities.campus: LDCE Smart Campus Navigator available on website.

innovation.research: Research papers, patents, and research grants

student_life.events: Technical and cultural events throughout the year

contact.student_section: Use Contact page on ldce.ac.in for department-wise phone and email.
